nodes.summary: For all integers $r \ge 2$ and $m \ge 1$ and every finite simple graph $G$ with exactly $rm$ vertices, (a) if every vertex of $G$ has degree at least $m(r - 1)$, then $G$ contains $m$ pairwise disjoint cliques of $r$ vertices each, and (b) if every vertex of $G$ has degree at most $m - 1$, then $G$ has a proper colouring with $m$ colours in which every colour class has exactly $r$ vertices.
nodes.title: Hajnal–Szemerédi theorem in clique-factor and equitable-colouring form

nodes.title: Erdős Problem 914 on clique factors and equitable colourings

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set with maximum degree $\Delta(G)$, and let $k$ be a natural number with $\Delta(G) < k$. Then $G$ has a proper coloring with the $k$ colors $0, 1, \dots, k-1$ that is equitable: for any two colors $i$ and $j$, the number of vertices of color $i$ is at most one more than the number of vertices of color $j$.
nodes.title: Equitable coloring with more colors than the maximum degree
